restaurants.name: Harbour Lantern
restaurants.alt: Modern Australian seafood dish served at Harbour Lantern
restaurants.description: Harbour Lantern offers a relaxed modern Australian dining experience with a focus on fresh seafood, seasonal produce, and familiar flavours presented with care. The menu suits guests who want something polished without feeling overly formal. It is a good choice for family celebrations, visitors wanting local flavours, or small business dinners where the atmosphere needs to feel calm, comfortable, and welcoming.

restaurants.name: Miso Moon
restaurants.alt: Japanese ramen and side dishes at Miso Moon
restaurants.description: Miso Moon is a warm Japanese restaurant built around ramen, rice bowls, and shareable starters. It works well for diners who want a balanced meal in a quieter setting, with enough variety for both simple and slightly more adventurous choices. The space is suited to casual dates, business lunches, and visitors looking for a dependable Japanese option near the city.

restaurants.name: Olive Courtyard
restaurants.alt: Mediterranean mezze platter at Olive Courtyard
restaurants.description: Olive Courtyard serves Mediterranean food designed for sharing, with colourful plates, grilled dishes, and plenty of vegetarian-friendly choices. The menu is flexible enough for families, couples, and mixed groups with different dietary needs. Its relaxed courtyard-style atmosphere makes it a strong option for diners who want generous food, lighter flavours, and a social meal that does not feel rushed.

restaurants.name: Spice Trail
restaurants.alt: Indian curries and naan served at Spice Trail
restaurants.description: Spice Trail is a lively Indian restaurant offering rich curries, grilled dishes, breads, and plant-based choices. It is especially suitable for groups because the menu is easy to share and includes a range of spice levels. The restaurant is a practical choice for families, students, and visitors who want strong flavours, generous portions, and good value without sacrificing variety.

restaurants.name: Green Fork
restaurants.alt: Plant-based salad bowl and smoothie at Green Fork
restaurants.description: Green Fork focuses on plant-based meals, fresh ingredients, and lighter dining options. The menu is designed for vegans, vegetarians, and anyone wanting a healthier meal without giving up flavour. It is a friendly option for casual lunches, relaxed dates, and small work catch-ups where guests may have different dietary preferences or want a quick but satisfying meal.

restaurants.name: Ember Room
restaurants.alt: Steakhouse main course served at Ember Room
restaurants.description: Ember Room is a premium steakhouse with a darker, more refined dining room suited to special occasions and professional meals. The menu centres on grilled meats, rich sides, and classic desserts, with some gluten-free options available. It is best for diners looking for a polished night out, a business dinner, or a date where the setting should feel more formal.
